name: uv_mutex_lock

ownership.argument: Locks a mutex initialized by uv_mutex_init. Corrects earlier raw pthread entry 0xC1E9B1C; this is the actual libuv void-return wrapper.

provenance.source: Feature enqueue 0xC865794 calls 0xC2DCDA8(manager+32). Wrapper BL 0xC1E9B1C (pthread_mutex_lock); nonzero result asserts through 0xC1E4180 at thread.c:358.

notes: Locks a mutex initialized by uv_mutex_init. Corrects earlier raw pthread entry 0xC1E9B1C; this is the actual libuv void-return wrapper.
